recentItems.title: Seshiro Kato (Gavroche) leads the Les Miz cast in Do You Hear The People Sing - Acapella!
recentItems.description:
Neat little a capella rendition of Do You Hear The People Sing by the 2011 Japanese cast of Les Miserables, led by Seshiro Kato who plays Gavroche (and is a famous actor).

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Four Little Cosettes sing "Castle On A Cloud"  - Japan 2018
recentItems.description:
And a final time from a showcase by the super talented 2018 Japanese Les Miserables cast, the little Cosettes perform their number "Castle On A Cloud". They are Ria Tominaga, Akane Matsuda, Nao Koyama, and Asuka Fujii.

recentItems.title: 8-YEAR-OLD boy sings "I Dreamed A Dream!" | Kazuki Higa as Gavroche  - Japan 2018
recentItems.description:
Once again from a showcase by the super talented 2018 Japanese Les Miserables cast, this time Kazuki Higa, the Gavroche alternate, sings Fantine's iconic "I Dreamed A Dream". Nothing like a little kid to make you feel talentless.

recentItems.title: Gavroche sings "I Dreamed A Dream!" | Itsuki Yamamoto  - Japan 2018
recentItems.description:
From a showcase by the super talented 2018 Japanese Les Miserables cast, Itsuki Yamamoto sings Fantine's iconic "I Dreamed A Dream", dress and all. This kid y'all. Do take a minute to listen.
